sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image–text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.

sources.title: blip-2: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview blip-2 is a vision-language model that answers questions about images and generates captions. Built by andreasjansson, this model bridges the modality gap between vision and language using a lightweight Querying Transformer that connects frozen pre-trained image encoders to frozen large language models. sources.title: BLIP Model Explained: How It’s Revolutionizing Vision-Language Models in AI
sources.snippet: This is the core problem that BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) sets out to solve in the world of AI. While earlier models could match an image to a simple label, BLIP is designed to build a deeper, more contextual understanding of how language and vision intertwine.
